SEC-NET-001.description: Verify IP access lists are configured to restrict network access
SEC-NET-001.recommendation: Configure IP access lists to restrict workspace access to known IP ranges. Review and update the whitelist regularly.

SEC-NET-002.description: Verify VPC peering is configured for secure network connectivity
SEC-NET-002.recommendation: Enable VPC peering to establish secure, private connectivity between your Databricks workspace and your VPC.

SEC-NET-003.description: Verify Private Link is enabled for secure connectivity
SEC-NET-003.recommendation: Enable Private Link to ensure all traffic between your network and Databricks stays on the cloud provider's backbone network.

SEC-NET-004.description: Verify secure cluster connectivity is enabled
SEC-NET-004.recommendation: Enable secure cluster connectivity (No Public IPs) to ensure cluster nodes don't have public IP addresses.

SEC-NET-005.recommendation: Configure private endpoints for secure access to Databricks services without exposing them to the public internet.

SEC-IAM-001.description: Verify SSO is enabled for centralized authentication
SEC-IAM-001.recommendation: Enable SSO integration with your identity provider (e.g., Azure AD, Okta) for centralized authentication and improved security.

SEC-IAM-002.description: Verify SCIM provisioning is enabled for automated user management
SEC-IAM-002.recommendation: Enable SCIM provisioning to automate user and group management, ensuring timely access revocation and consistent permissions.

SEC-IAM-003.description: Verify MFA is enforced for all users
SEC-IAM-003.recommendation: Enforce MFA for all users through your identity provider to add an additional layer of security.

SEC-IAM-004.description: Verify admin user count is within acceptable limits
SEC-IAM-004.recommendation: Minimize the number of workspace admins to reduce security risk. Follow principle of least privilege.

SEC-DATA-001.description: Verify encryption at rest is enabled for all clusters
SEC-DATA-001.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest for all clusters using customer-managed keys (CMK) for enhanced security and compliance.

SEC-DATA-002.description: Verify secrets are managed using external secret stores
SEC-DATA-002.expected_value: External secret store (Azure Key Vault/AWS Secrets Manager)
SEC-DATA-002.recommendation: Use external secret stores (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) instead of Databricks-backed scopes for better security and compliance.

SEC-DATA-003.description: Verify credential passthrough is enabled for secure data access
SEC-DATA-003.recommendation: Enable credential passthrough to ensure users access data using their own credentials, providing better audit trails and access control.

SEC-DATA-004.description: Verify notebook results are stored in customer-managed storage account
SEC-DATA-004.expected_value: Customer-managed storage configured for notebook results
SEC-DATA-004.recommendation: Configure notebook results to be stored in your customer-managed storage account instead of Databricks-managed storage for better data control and compliance. This ensures interactive notebook results (dataframes, visualizations) are stored in your own storage infrastructure.

SEC-GOV-001.description: Verify table ACLs are enabled for data access control
SEC-GOV-001.recommendation: Enable table ACLs to control access to databases, tables, and views. Migrate to Unity Catalog for more granular control.

SEC-GOV-002.description: Verify Unity Catalog is enabled for unified governance
SEC-GOV-002.recommendation: Enable Unity Catalog for unified governance across all workspaces, with fine-grained access control and centralized metadata management.

SEC-GOV-003.description: Verify audit logging is enabled for compliance
SEC-GOV-003.recommendation: Enable and configure audit logging to track user activities, API calls, and changes to workspace configurations for compliance and security monitoring.

SEC-GOV-004.description: Verify catalogs are properly isolated for multi-tenancy
SEC-GOV-004.recommendation: Implement proper catalog isolation using Unity Catalog to ensure data segregation and access control in multi-tenant environments.

SEC-COMP-001.description: Verify appropriate security profile is configured
SEC-COMP-001.recommendation: Configure an appropriate security profile based on your compliance requirements. High security profile provides enhanced security controls.

SEC-COMP-002.description: Verify Enhanced Security Monitoring is enabled
SEC-COMP-002.recommendation: Enable Enhanced Security Monitoring for advanced threat detection and security monitoring capabilities.

SEC-COMP-003.description: Verify security analysis tools are deployed
SEC-COMP-003.recommendation: Deploy security analysis tools to regularly assess your workspace security posture and identify potential vulnerabilities.

SEC-COMP-004.description: Verify regular security scans are configured
SEC-COMP-004.expected_value: Regular scans configured (weekly or more frequent)
SEC-COMP-004.recommendation: Configure regular security scans to continuously monitor your workspace security posture and identify issues proactively.

SEC-DATA-005.description: Verify notebook export is disabled or controlled to prevent data exfiltration
SEC-DATA-005.recommendation: Disable notebook export or implement strict controls to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration. This setting controls whether users can export notebooks containing sensitive data and code.

SEC-DATA-006.description: Verify clipboard access from notebooks is disabled or controlled
SEC-DATA-006.recommendation: Disable or control clipboard access from notebook tables to prevent accidental data leakage through copy-paste operations.

SEC-DATA-007.description: Verify query results downloading is disabled or controlled
SEC-DATA-007.recommendation: Disable query results downloading to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration. Control both workspace and SQL-specific download settings.

SEC-DATA-008.description: Verify dashboard email subscriptions are controlled
SEC-DATA-008.recommendation: Control or disable dashboard email subscriptions to prevent unintended data sharing via email.

SEC-IAM-005.description: Verify legacy access control methods are disabled
SEC-IAM-005.recommendation: Disable legacy access control to enforce modern authentication and authorization mechanisms. Legacy access methods may have security vulnerabilities.

SEC-DATA-009.description: Verify legacy DBFS access is disabled
SEC-DATA-009.recommendation: Disable legacy DBFS access to enforce secure data access patterns through Unity Catalog and modern data governance controls.

SEC-GOV-005.description: Verify ABAC row-level security is enabled
SEC-GOV-005.recommendation: Enable Attribute-Based Access Control for fine-grained row-level security in Unity Catalog tables.

SEC-COMP-005.description: Verify account-level IP access control is enabled (Azure)
SEC-COMP-005.recommendation: Enable account-level IP access control to restrict access to the Databricks account console from known IP ranges only.

SEC-DATA-010.description: Verify customer-managed keys are enabled for Unity Catalog (Azure)
SEC-DATA-010.recommendation: Enable customer-managed keys (CMK) for Unity Catalog to maintain control over encryption keys for your data governance layer.

SEC-COMP-006.description: Verify governance tagging is enabled for compliance tracking (Azure)
SEC-COMP-006.recommendation: Enable governance tagging to support compliance requirements and resource tracking across the organization.

SEC-COMP-007.description: Verify external data connectors are reviewed and approved
SEC-COMP-007.expected_value: External connectors (JDBC, SFTP, Salesforce, etc.) reviewed and controlled
SEC-COMP-007.recommendation: Review and control access to external data connectors including JDBC, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SFTP, SharePoint, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, and Dynamics. Ensure only authorized connectors are enabled and properly configured.

SEC-GOV-006.description: Verify Unity Catalog enhanced UI is enabled for better governance visibility
SEC-GOV-006.recommendation: Enable enhanced Unity Catalog UI for improved data governance visibility and user experience.

SEC-IAM-006.description: Verify AI agent monitoring is enabled for AI workload security
SEC-IAM-006.recommendation: Enable AI agent monitoring to track and audit AI agent activities and ensure secure AI workload execution.

SEC-COMP-008.description: Verify token management policies are configured (workspace settings)
SEC-COMP-008.expected_value: Token lifetime limits configured, long-lived tokens reviewed
SEC-COMP-008.recommendation: Configure token management policies to enforce token expiration and regularly review long-lived tokens. Minimize tokens without expiry dates.
